description: Polyperc 1 on channel 1 plays a bass at velocity 48: MIDI 48 on steps 1, 5 and 13 and MIDI 55 on step 9 of each bar. Doubledecker on channel 2 plays chords (velocity 32, three steps long) on steps 1 and 9 with root MIDI 60 then 62, Chd1 set to 3rd and Chd2 set to 5th, which gives C-E-G and D-F-A in C major. Four bars at 90 BPM, a four-step cycle that repeats every bar. Listen for the chord changing every half bar, at beat 1 and again at beat 3, over a steady bass. The Doubledecker chords are the more prominent layer in this mix and the Polyperc bass sits underneath them. Build it with the Separate fixed bass-and-chord example recipe.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
title: A bass with room above it
